summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong coverage of core functionality: date classification (expired/warning/ok) with extensive boundary testing, config loading with error handling, report generation in two formats, CLI entry point with all exit codes, and workflow structure validation. Integration harness exercises the full pipeline through act. Minor gaps: -OutFile parameter untested, GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY environment variable not tested, no scale/malformed-data edge cases (e.g., requiredBy as string instead of array). Integration tests rely on substring matching in large output blocks which could be brittle if formatting changes. Overall, tests would catch most regressions and demonstrate red/green TDD rigor with proper fixture strategy and deterministic reference dates.
